conflictsOfInterest: The reviewer is the project founder and owner. The review records that role explicitly; it is an internal owner decision, not independent external validation.
method: Guided interactive review on 2026-11-08 in four blocks (governance and provenance; records and configuration; wizard, store and setup; boundaries and closure), each presented with its evidence and limits.

humanReview.rationale: Approve BL.0 within its documented scope: proposed-then-accepted governance, MIT provenance, content-free records, validated configuration with fixed constants, preview/apply wizard, private run store and setup consent. Limits stated in each evidence record apply.

milestoneClosure.rationale: Close BL.0. This does not approve BL.1-BL.5, any rollout, model call, optimization result or execution authority.
